safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not state there is no prior history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute insect-sting reaction, documenting absence of prior anaphylaxis helps risk-stratify and guides urgency (e.g., ED referral, epinephrine planning). Omitting this may lead to more conservative management or unnecessary escalation due to uncertainty, but is unlikely to directly cause serious harm by itself.
